title: NHKマイルCの後に・芝でも砂でも

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The NHK Mile Cup draws to a close. Taiki Shuttle is overjoyed, having brought happiness to so many people.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her next goal is where all the ace Umamusume gather—the Mile Championship!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We enter the Unicorn Stakes in the meantime—the perfect race to gain some much-needed experience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Preparing for the big stage ahead, Taiki Shuttle tackles the dirt track head-on.
